# -- tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_grant_reward_effect ----------------------------------------------
tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_grant_reward_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_total_favorable value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_duty_relic_inventory_status ?= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_total_favorable add = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_duty_relic_inventory_status ?= 3 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_total_favorable add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_duty_alms_ledger_status ?= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_total_favorable add = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_duty_alms_ledger_status ?= 3 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_total_favorable add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_duty_pilgrim_threshold_status ?= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_total_favorable add = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_duty_pilgrim_threshold_status ?= 3 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_total_favorable add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_duty_choir_offices_status ?= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_total_favorable add = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_duty_choir_offices_status ?= 3 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_total_favorable add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_duty_chapel_patronage_status ?= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_total_favorable add = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_duty_chapel_patronage_status ?= 3 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_total_favorable add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_total_favorable >= 10 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_reward_modifier years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
		add_prestige = 12
		if = {
			limit = { country_has_estate = estate_type:clergy_estate }
			add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = 0.05 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_total_favorable >= 9 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_reward_modifier years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
		add_prestige = 6
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_reward_modifier_lesser years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
		add_prestige = 2
	}
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_total_favorable
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_stage
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_assigned_role
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_pending_event
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_completed value = 1 }
	tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
}

# -- tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_monthly_progress_effect ----------------------------------------------
tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_monthly_progress_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_active_trigger = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_pending_event }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_stage ?= 0 tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_site_control_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1678 days = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_stage ?= 1 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1679 days = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_stage ?= 2 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1680 days = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_stage ?= 3 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_st_peters_basilica_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1681 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}
